name: Quarterly compliance readiness keeper
why: Runs the quarterly gap check for a named framework, matching the quarterly compliance review workflow.

name: Compliance evidence request assistant
why: Finds expired or missing evidence and drafts a request for each owner, as in step 5 of the audit evidence pack.

name: Prepare evidence for a compliance review
why: Builds an evidence index and gap list before an auditor starts.

name: Prepare a vendor security questionnaire response
why: Answers a customer's security questionnaire with sourced evidence instead of claims.

name: Plain-words contract summary
why: A quick version of the contract plain summary skill: what you owe, what they owe and the risky clauses.

name: Contract intake reviewer
why: Reviews each new contract with clauses to question; a lawyer still checks, as in the new vendor intake workflow.

name: Monthly contract renewal keeper
why: Keeps the renewal and notice dates from the contract tracker in front of the owner each month.

name: Prepare a contract renewal negotiation
why: Turns a renewal date in the tracker into a notice plan and keep, renegotiate or replace options.

name: Rule change policy keeper
why: Checks policies against a changed rule and drafts small redrafts, like the policy gap check prompt.

name: Make a new policy understandable to staff
why: Explains an approved policy to staff in plain words once it is published.

name: Rough notes to minutes writer
why: Short minutes from rough notes for smaller meetings; formal board minutes use the board minutes prompt.

name: Prepare a board decision brief
why: Prepares the evidence and options for a board decision before the meeting.

name: Review employee data access before a change
why: A who-can-see-what privacy review for staff data before an HR system change.
